mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong employment supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a supply shock, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
